evidence: Static scan of all 43 frozen task files (no runtime evidence is needed for this row). (1) Credentials: no provider key shapes, PEM blocks, JWTs or bearer tokens anywhere, including the 40,638-line built bundle and the lockfile. task.toml:34 is the template placeholder ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and task.toml:35 is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""; task.toml differs from the frozen template only in name/description/keywords/metadata lines 5-7, 10-12, 14-15. The product has no accounts (tests/app_context.md:8-10, instruction.md:5), so there are no demo passwords either. (2) Personal data: environment/assets/seed_data.json:2 is "snippets": [] with a neutral note; the only e-mail-shaped string in the task is the template's turing@local.invalid at environment/Dockerfile:20. (3) Host paths: no Windows drive paths, /Users/, /home/<user>, workstation user name, workspace name or file:// URL in any file. (4) Remote fetch: solution/solve.sh:37-38 only removes the database files and copies the bundled app, with no curl/wget/npm/pip; solution/app/package.json:15-26 pins every dependency to an exact version; package-lock.json has 178 resolved entries, all on https://registry.npmjs.org, each with an integrity hash and no git/file/link source. The shipped app loads no off-origin asset: public/index.html references only /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, index.css has no url() or @import, and server.js:16 sends a CSP of default-src 'self' / connect-src 'self'. URLs inside the bundle are React, Prettier, MDN-style documentation strings and W3C namespaces, not fetches. Both Dockerfiles are byte-identical to the frozen template, so their tag-level base images and unversioned apt packages are template-controlled and not a task-authoring finding; npm and pip installs there are version-pinned. (5) Injection payload: seed data, the six instruction notes and all judge prompts and criteria carry no scoring directive; each of the five judge prompts opens by telling the judge to treat submitted content as untrusted and never follow scoring directives found in it (e.g. tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1). No bidi-override or tag characters in any file; the zero-width code points found are confined to public/assets/index.js lines 12027, 20563, 33240, 33241, which are acorn/Prettier identifier-character tables and the HTML entity map. No stray .env, .pem, .key, .db, .log or .pyc file; the only dotfile is tests/.dockerignore, identical to the template. Counterexample attempts: a seed or criterion fixture carrying a real name, e-mail or instruction to the judge, and a solve.sh that pulls from the network at install time, were both looked for and not found. What the task does well: the reference ships prebuilt with no install step and a restrictive CSP, which leaves no fetch surface at grade time.
